title: UI Testing Metrics
description: Schema for the 'UI Testing' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: UITEST-1: count of inline multi-step flows and duplicated navigation sequences that should be in a coordinator
UITEST-2: count of test suites inheriting directly from XCTestCase or managing app lifecycle/setup directly
UITEST-3: count of fragmented assertion groups where related assertions could be a single test with one setup preamble
UITEST-4: count of time-based waits (sleep, fixed timeouts) and unchecked element accesses without expectation-based synchronization
UITEST-5: count of raw string literals used to query app-owned UI elements (should use typed identifier constants)
